contract: target table and columns must match repository-owned ClickHouse schemas
projection columns must be unique and include required identity fields
projection rows must be non-empty and match the selected column width
unsupported projections are permanently dead-lettered with a fixed reason before ClickHouse is opened
valid projections preserve existing lease fencing, retry backoff, and idempotent insert token behavior
isolation: Synthetic rows and repository schema files only; no database, ClickHouse service, candidate, legacy stack, or provider was accessed.
